skill.name: azure-ai-document-intelligence-ts

content.value_statement: Document extraction workflows require precise Azure REST SDK patterns and asynchronous operation handling. This skill provides practical TypeScript guidance for analysis, classification, and custom models.
actual_capabilities: Configures the Azure Document Intelligence REST client with DefaultAzureCredential or an API key.
Analyzes documents from remote URLs or local files with prebuilt Azure models.
Extracts page, table, invoice, receipt, and line-item information from analysis results.
Lists available document models and reads custom model service limits.
Builds custom models and document classifiers from Azure Blob Storage training data.
Uses Azure long-running pollers and typed error checks for asynchronous operations.
limitations: Requires an Azure Document Intelligence resource, valid credentials, and the listed npm packages.
Examples are implementation patterns, not a complete application with validation, retries, monitoring, or deployment configuration.
Local file analysis sends encoded document content to Azure, so users must apply privacy, residency, and retention controls.
Extraction quality varies by document and model; confidence thresholds and human review remain application responsibilities.

use_cases.title: Automate Invoice Extraction
use_cases.description: Create a TypeScript workflow that extracts vendor, total, due date, and line-item fields from invoices.

use_cases.title: Classify Incoming Documents
use_cases.description: Build and use a classifier that separates invoices, receipts, and other document types stored in Azure.

use_cases.title: Train Specialized Models
use_cases.description: Configure custom template or neural models from labeled documents in Azure Blob Storage.

prompt_templates.title: Configure the Client
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me how to install and configure the Azure Document Intelligence REST client in TypeScript using DefaultAzureCredential and an environment-based endpoint.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a Local Invoice
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a TypeScript example that reads [file path], analyzes it with prebuilt-invoice, checks errors, polls completion, and reports key invoice fields.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Document Classifier
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a classifier for [document types] using training data under [Azure Blob prefixes]. Include environment configuration, polling, and result checks.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Production Analysis Module
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a typed TypeScript module for URL and local-file analysis using [model ID]. Include authentication choices, error handling, polling, pagination, and confidence thresholds.

output_examples.input: Analyze a local invoice and report the vendor, total, and due date.
output: A TypeScript workflow reads and encodes the selected invoice.
The prebuilt invoice model runs through an Azure long-running poller.
The result handling reports vendor, total, and due date fields when available.

output_examples.input: Build a classifier for invoices and receipts stored in separate Azure Blob prefixes.
output_examples.output: A classifier design maps each document type to its storage prefix, starts the build operation, checks errors, and reports the classifier identifier.

output_examples.input: List document models and show current custom model capacity.
output_examples.output: A paginated model inventory is paired with the service limit and current custom model count.

best_practices: Prefer DefaultAzureCredential when managed identity or developer identity is available.
Check isUnexpected before creating a poller, and handle failed long-running operations explicitly.
Select the narrowest suitable model and enforce field confidence thresholds for the business workflow.
anti_patterns: Do not hardcode API keys, SAS URLs, or resource-specific endpoints in source files.
Do not send regulated or confidential documents without approved Azure privacy and residency controls.
Do not assume extracted fields are correct when confidence values or required fields are missing.

faq.question: Which Azure package does this skill use?
faq.answer: It uses @azure-rest/ai-document-intelligence and optionally @azure/identity for DefaultAzureCredential.

faq.question: Can it analyze local files?
faq.answer: Yes. The example reads a local file, converts it to base64, and sends it to Azure for analysis.

faq.question: Does it support documents hosted at a URL?
faq.answer: Yes. Azure can analyze a document through a supplied URL when the service can access that location.

faq.question: Which prebuilt models are covered?
faq.answer: The guidance covers read, layout, invoice, receipt, identity, tax, health insurance, contract, and bank statement models.

faq.question: Can it create custom models and classifiers?
faq.answer: Yes. Examples use Azure Blob SAS URLs to build custom models and multi-type document classifiers.

faq.question: Does the skill guarantee extraction accuracy?
faq.answer: No. Applications must evaluate confidence values, validate required fields, and add human review where errors have material impact.
